Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Year" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] served as '''leader''' of [[Squad 79]], a unit within the [[InterStellar Regulators]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] assigned Squad 79 to attack a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] strike team. The squad leader led her forces but were defeated by the Imperials.<ref name="Descent into the Core" />
